note: English Mastery settings (design note 02.11.26). The Ledger page computes every score from the raw counts in each session's `mastery` block; changing a number here recalculates the whole history. Cumulative = totals first, then divided. Voice and typed are scored separately; Combined = word-weighted; Speaking = voice only.

grammar.formula: Grammar = (Accuracy + Range) / 2; Accuracy = (Concept mastery + Grammar-clean sentences) / 2
grammar.concepts: meta/registry, every concept except err_* and old_* (84)

speaking.formula: Speaking = average of Flow, Depth, Cohesion and Fillers, each mapped 0-100 between its zero and full point and clipped

depth.unit: % of replies that develop an idea

fillers.unit: uh/um + word fillers per 100 words (lower is better)

calibration.rule: For each measure, the median of the first 5 voice sessions with speaking counts scores 50 and the second-best of them scores 75 (at least 15% of the median apart, so near-identical days don't make the scale jumpy); zero and full points follow from that line.
